summary_short.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
summary_short.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable comp…
summary_short.es: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable comp…

summary_short.zh: Datagouv-MCP是法国国家开放数据平台的官方MCP服务器，它让AI聊天机器人能够通过对话直接访问数千个公共数据集。该项目采用模型上下文协议标准，将自然语言查询转换为结构化API调用，使聊天机器人能够搜索、探索和分析数据，无需人工浏览平台。开发者可将其集成到现有AI助手中，构建数据驱动的问答系统或自动化研究工具，通过简单对话即可利用法国政府开放数据，为公民服务、商业分析或学术研究提供便利。
summary_short.en: Datagouv-MCP is an official Model Context Protocol server that connects AI chatbots to France's national open data platform, enabling conversational access to thousands of datasets. It implements the MCP standard to translate natural language queries into structured API calls, a…

summary_short.zh: Paddle（飞桨）是一个开源深度学习框架，致力于将大规模AI模型的研究创新转化为实际工业应用。其核心技术包括原生支持并行分布式训练，通过高效的C++后端和灵活架构，实现单机或多机环境下的高性能计算与资源优化。开发者可利用该框架构建自定义神经网络，调用丰富的预训练模块加速开发，并轻松部署模型至云端、移动端或边缘设备，适用于智能制造、自动驾驶等需要高可靠性与可扩展性的场景。
summary_short.en: Paddle is an open-source deep learning framework designed to bridge the gap between industrial AI development and research, enabling efficient model training and deployment at scale. Its core strength lies in native support for parallel distributed training, allowing seamless sc…
summary_short.es: Paddle is an open-source deep learning framework designed to bridge the gap between industrial AI development and research, enabling efficient model training and deployment at scale. Its core strength lies in native support for parallel distributed training, allowing seamless sc…

summary_short.zh: MobileAgent是一个开源框架，利用多模态大语言模型解析移动应用界面，将屏幕元素视为视觉标记进行感知，使AI智能体能够自主执行触摸、滑动等操作，无需手动编写脚本即可自动化复杂手机任务。该框架可集成到应用测试中，构建自动化助手处理重复操作，或通过训练自定义界面扩展能力，创建针对特定场景的专用智能体。
summary_short.en: MobileAgent is an open-source framework that enables AI agents to autonomously operate mobile applications by interpreting and interacting with graphical user interfaces, solving the challenge of automating complex mobile tasks without manual scripting. Its core innovation lies …

summary_short.zh: Superset是一款专为AI智能体时代设计的集成开发环境，帮助开发者在本地高效管理和运行多个AI编程助手，如Claude Code和Codex。它通过将不同AI代理集成到统一的桌面应用中，并支持Git工作树功能，让开发者能在多个代码分支上并行测试AI的编程建议。这种设计使得你可以同时比较不同AI助手的代码生成效果，快速筛选最佳方案，并将其融入实际开发流程，从而提升编程效率与实验灵活性。
summary_short.en: Superset is an IDE designed for the AI agents era, enabling developers to efficiently manage and run multiple AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex locally. Its technical innovation lies in integrating these agents into a unified desktop environment with Git worktree s…
summary_short.es: Superset is an IDE designed for the AI agents era, enabling developers to efficiently manage and run multiple AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex locally. Its technical innovation lies in integrating these agents into a unified desktop environment with Git worktree s…

summary_short.zh: Sub2API-CRS2 是一个开源API中转网关，解决了开发者需要同时接入Claude、OpenAI、Gemini等多种AI服务时的协议碎片化问题。其技术核心在于创建统一接口层，抽象不同服务的专属协议，同时保持原生工具的无缝兼容。通过自部署代理服务，你可以集中管理多个AI API访问，用单一端点实验不同模型能力，或构建团队协作的成本分摊系统，让AI服务集成变得更简洁高效。
summary_short.en: Sub2API-CRS2 is an open-source API gateway that solves the fragmentation problem when developers need to access multiple AI services like Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini. Its technical insight lies in creating a unified interface that abstracts away service-specific protocols while m…
summary_short.es: Sub2API-CRS2 is an open-source API gateway that solves the fragmentation problem when developers need to access multiple AI services like Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini. Its technical insight lies in creating a unified interface that abstracts away service-specific protocols while m…

summary_short.zh: Hermes-Agent是一个开源框架，使大语言模型能够自主执行多步骤任务，通过分解复杂目标实现自动化。其模块化架构集成专用工具处理搜索、文件操作等功能，并通过推理循环协调执行顺序。该框架可应用于数据分析、内容生成等系统，用户通过配置工具库和定义任务目标构建智能代理，从而扩展语言模型能力，实现超越纯文本交互的实用自动化。
summary_short.en: Hermes-Agent is an open-source framework that enables large language models to autonomously execute multi-step tasks by breaking them down into actionable steps. Its key innovation is a modular architecture where specialized tools handle specific operations like web search or fi…
summary_short.es: Hermes-Agent is an open-source framework that enables large language models to autonomously execute multi-step tasks by breaking them down into actionable steps. Its key innovation is a modular architecture where specialized tools handle specific operations like web search or fi…

summary_short.zh: Claude Code 是一款基于终端的AI编程助手，它通过自然语言命令帮助开发者自动化日常任务并理解复杂代码库。其核心在于能够分析整个代码仓库的上下文，直接在开发环境中提供智能建议并执行命令。你可以用它生成样板代码、调试现有函数或管理Git工作流——只需用简单英语描述需求，它就能处理具体的实现细节，让编程工作更高效直观。
summary_short.en: Claude Code is a terminal-based AI coding assistant that helps developers automate routine tasks and understand complex codebases through natural language commands. It works by analyzing your entire code repository context to provide intelligent suggestions and execute commands …
